public-value-v1.adversarialWitness: Repeated reads do not traverse retained domain state.

public-callable-v1.resourceRationale: The conservative fallback includes validation/output allocation and requires surface overrides for host resources.
public-callable-v1.proof: The conservative public ceiling permits one pass over input, retained state, and produced output; registered hot operations provide tighter source proof.
public-callable-v1.adversarialWitness: Maximum-size external input with maximum-size retained state and full snapshot output.

fullScan.rationale: The public fallback admits external validation and explicit full-output materialization; hot canonical paths require a tighter operation contract.

constant-v1.resourceRationale: Indexed/scalar trusted-state observations retain no new collection resource.
constant-v1.proof: The operation performs a bounded number of indexed reads or scalar steps.
constant-v1.adversarialWitness: Maximum-size retained state does not increase deterministic work.

fullScan.rationale: Indexed or scalar work must not traverse the domain.

assumptions: external input is validated exactly once at its boundary

linear-v1.resourceRationale: Linear construction/projection may allocate one bounded entry per visited or emitted item.
linear-v1.proof: One bounded traversal visits each relevant input/state entry and emits at most k entries.
linear-v1.adversarialWitness: Every input entry is visited and every eligible entry is emitted.

fullScan.rationale: Construction, external validation, or explicit full projection has a linear lower bound.

lifecycle-v1.resourceRationale: Only connection-owned ancestors, affected targets, and one bounded scheduler/observer set may be retained.
lifecycle-v1.proof: Connection work visits owned resources and only affected projection targets.

fullScan.rationale: Mounted updates may scan owned resources or affected targets, never unrelated global connections.
